decisions.reason: The air quality module fits the firm's core environmental sensing line and costs little to carry in a modular catalogue, so no performance shortfall triggers search, although the 2022 component shortages add some risk.
As the current generation of a basic voltage measurement module it is a staple of the building-block platform, and dropping it would leave a gap rather than free resources.
The MQTT proxy still adds IoT value at low cost, but it may be superseded by MQTT support built into the newer software bindings, which raises the chance of withdrawal.
Demand from schools and building automation for CO2 monitoring has risen since 2020, so the product likely meets or exceeds its aspiration level.
